commands.graph: shifu docs graph --output DIR [--policy FILE] [--xinfa FILE] [--json]
commands.pack: shifu docs pack --output DIR [--policy FILE] [--xinfa FILE] [--json]
commands.impact: shifu docs impact --since DIR [--policy FILE] [--xinfa FILE] [--json]

versionNegotiation.unsupported: fail with schema-version; never downgrade silently

authorityBoundaries.project: domain documents, profiles, provider instances, routes, and policy selection
authorityBoundaries.shifu: safe exact filesystem discovery, project conformance diagnostics, product Gates, and validation receipts; no semantic graph or project-root authority
authorityBoundaries.xinfa: semantic project materialization, nodes, edges, route selection, canonicalization, validation, and content-addressed roots
authorityBoundaries.productRuntime: read-only verification and exact consumption of the selected Xinfa Atlas, catalog, content, and precompiled projections
authorityBoundaries.buildchain: exact source, artifact, Atlas, pack, cut, claim-graph, and qualification attestation without redefining documentation semantics
authorityBoundaries.humanReview: clarity, purpose, and contested semantic review without rewriting machine results

compatibility.legacyDocsCheck: unchanged compatibility input; not a second protocol authority
compatibility.probeExecution: never during docs validate; only through a referenced Shifu Gate registry
compatibility.majorVersion: required for removals, new required fields, or changed meanings
compatibility.surfacePolicy: optional additive v1 field; absence preserves the original six-provider validation meaning
compatibility.agentOnboardingPack: compatibility alias for onboarding and skills only; never a documentation compiler or selector
